instructions: Lay out 8 slices of bread in pairs.
Spread 2 tbsp of peanut butter on one slice of each pair.
Spread 1 tbsp of jelly on the other slice of each pair.
Press each pair together and cut the sandwiches in half. Cut them diagonally if you like.
Wrap each sandwich or pack it in a lunchbox.
method_notes: Only one version was readable: Cooking with Curls (no rating shown). It is the classic build of two slices, peanut butter on one and preserves on the other, about 2 tbsp of peanut butter and 1 tbsp of preserves per sandwich. Check the bread label if the sandwich needs to be dairy-free.
